title: Higher-rank local mixing for cusped positive representations
summary: Let $Γ<\operatorname{PSL}_2(\mathbb R)$ be a torsion-free, non-elementary, finitely generated Fuchsian group with parabolic elements, and let $ρ:Γ\to G$ be a type-preserving, Zariski dense, positive representation into a connected split semisimple real algebraic group. We prove quantitative local mixing for Bowen--Margulis--Sullivan measures on $ρ(Γ)\backslash G/M$, where $M$ is the centralizer of a maximal split torus in a compatible maximal compact subgroup.
